s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and mass
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
wide segmental resection performed without complication

raw.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and mass
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
wide segmental resection performed without complication

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical and histopathological features, including small-bowel mass and specific immunohistochemical profile

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
shortlist.why_kept: common cause of small-bowel masses, although immunohistochemical profile does not fully match

shortlist.label: Carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: possible cause of small-bowel mass and gastrointestinal bleeding, but less likely given histopathological features

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: rare tumor that could present with small-bowel mass, but less likely given clinical context

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches histopathological features, including nested and fascicular patterns, and immunohistochemical profile

raw.rationale: The tumor's morphology, with uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, and immunohistochemical profile, including diffuse positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, are consistent with gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
rejected.why: Negative CD117, DOG1, and CD34 immunohistochemical stains argue against GIST.

rejected.label: Carcinoid tumor
rejected.why: The absence of chromogranin and CD56 expression, and the presence of S100 and SOX10 positivity, make carcinoid tumor less likely.

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: While S100 positivity is seen in MPNST, the clinical context and other immunohistochemical findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Clear cell sarcoma
rejected.why: The location in the gastrointestinal tract and the specific immunohistochemical profile suggest a gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma rather than a clear cell sarcoma of tendons and aponeuroses.
